A caution carried forward: a separate, frequently-resurfacing story about Canada removing retaliatory tariffs on CUSMA-compliant US goods actually dates to August/September 2025, not 2026, and should not be conflated with this year's escalation.

ELITE.compositionNote: Elite Pools & Unified Portfolios continue to draw on PIMCO, Loomis Sayles and iAGAM as sub-advisors. The new iA Clarington International Multifactor Equity Fund ETF Series (ticker IIME) opened on the TSX Sep 18/26, run on a 20+ factor quant strategy with a 0.50% management fee -- a fresh product for advisors interested in factor-based international equity exposure. The Tej Rai/Alex Bellefleur handover of four segregated funds to iAGAM's Asset Allocation team (effective Sep 14/26) is now corroborated across three independent research passes, with new context that Sebastien Mc Mahon's move to Chief Economist (announced May 19/26) created the opening this team filled; the handover is still not confirmed via a direct primary-source fetch. Loomis Sayles' Alpha Engine Perspectives titles cited in a prior run could not be reconfirmed today and should be treated as unconfirmed. PIMCO's only fresh item this window is a routine Q3 2026 distribution announcement (Sep 15/26) for its Canadian ETF Series, not new market commentary; PIMCO's Monthly Income Fund (Canada) remains understood to make up roughly 30% of iA Clarington's Elite Core Plus Global Fixed Income Pool (carried forward, not reconfirmed today). The most consequential development for the broader iA Clarington shelf remains the Canada-US trade war: a US 50% tariff on Canadian goods took effect around Aug 22/26 (affected-goods dollar figure unreconciled across sources, ~$20B-$27.6B) and Canada's retaliation took effect Sep 8/26, with no new escalation found in the last two days -- still a live, dated backdrop against which every sub-advisor's positioning can be discussed concretely. iA Clarington's overall AUM (>$26B, Jul 31/26) and iAGAM's firm-wide AUM ($156B, Jun 30/26) were both carried forward unchanged.
